name: sod_en
title: Society of Distrust, English edition (2021)
note: The same 3880 respondents and ids as sod, with the survey's own English value labels: an English-valued profile for the English description and framing. Region names come back as the canonical Czech names every reference and language pack keys on (regions.json beside the cleaning maps the English labels onto them); districts are Czech proper nouns in both editions. The raw .sav sits beside the Czech one under datasets/sod/SoD-EN/ and is not in git.
